title: Yellow Glazed Mexican Seitan Fajitas
description: A resinous and shattering midnight craving Mexican dish featuring flax eggs and a sweet yellow glaze, served in a terracotta dish, this recipe is onion and garlic free, making it suitable for those with sensitivities.

ingredients.name: yellow glaze
ingredients.notes: made with turmeric and pineapple juice

instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium high heat.
Add the olive oil and saute the sliced bell peppers and zucchini until tender.
Add the seitan and cook until browned on all sides.
In a small bowl, whisk together the flax eggs and yellow glaze.
Pour the glaze mixture over the seitan and vegetables, stirring to coat.
Add the fajita seasoning and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the glaze is caramelized.
Warm the flour tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the fajitas by placing a portion of the seitan and vegetable mixture onto a tortilla and serving immediately.
Serve in a terracotta dish for a traditional presentation.
